+    def _content_has_image(self, content: Any) -> bool:
+        return isinstance(content, list) and any(isinstance(part, ImageContent) for part in content)
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def _inline_data_from_data_url(image_url: str) -> Optional[Dict[str, str]]:
+        """REST Blob for a data URL. JSON uses camelCase, unlike the SDK's inline_data."""
+        if not image_url.startswith("data:image/") or "," not in image_url:
+            return None
+        header, data = image_url.split(",", 1)
+        if not data:
+            return None
+        mime_type = header[5:].split(";", 1)[0]
+        if not mime_type.startswith("image/"):
+            return None
+        return {"mimeType": mime_type, "data": data}
+
+    def _user_message_rest_parts(self, msg: AIMessage) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
+        """User/system parts. Text-only stays one placeholder string; data URLs become inlineData."""
+        if not self._content_has_image(msg.content):
+            text = self._messages_to_plaintext_prompt([msg])
+            return [{"text": text}] if text else []
+
+        parts: List[Dict[str, Any]] = []
+        text_bits: List[str] = []
+        prefix_pending = True
+
+        def flush() -> None:
+            nonlocal prefix_pending
+            if prefix_pending:
+                prefix = f"[{msg.role.value.upper()}]: "
+                prefix_pending = False
+            else:
+                prefix = ""
+            body = " ".join(text_bits)
+            text_bits.clear()
+            text = prefix + body if body else prefix.rstrip()
+            if text:
+                parts.append({"text": text})
+
+        for part in msg.content:
+            if isinstance(part, TextContent):
+                if part.text:
+                    text_bits.append(part.text)
+            elif isinstance(part, ImageContent):
+                url = part.image_url.get("url", "") if isinstance(part.image_url, dict) else ""
+                inline = self._inline_data_from_data_url(url)
+                if inline is None:
+                    text_bits.append(f"[Image: {url}]" if url else "[Image]")
+                    continue
+                flush()
+                parts.append({"inlineData": inline})
+        flush()
+        return parts
+

+@pytest.mark.asyncio
+async def test_google_provider_rest_sends_data_url_images_as_inline_data(monkeypatch):
+    from landppt.ai.base import AIMessage, ImageContent, MessageRole, TextContent
+
+    payloads = _fake_rest_session(
+        monkeypatch, [{"candidates": [{"content": {"parts": [{"text": "a chart"}]}, "finishReason": "STOP"}]}]
+    )
+    messages = [
+        AIMessage(
+            role=MessageRole.USER,
+            content=[
+                TextContent(text="describe this"),
+                ImageContent(image_url={"url": "data:image/png;base64,QUJD"}),
+                ImageContent(image_url={"url": "https://example.com/photo.jpg"}),
+            ],
+        )
+    ]
+
+    await _rest_provider().chat_completion(messages)
+
+    # A mirror never sees the data URL flattened into placeholder text.
+    assert payloads[0]["contents"] == [
+        {
+            "role": "user",
+            "parts": [
+                {"text": "[USER]: describe this"},
+                {"inlineData": {"mimeType": "image/png", "data": "QUJD"}},
+                {"text": "[Image: https://example.com/photo.jpg]"},
+            ],
+        }
+    ]
+
+
+@pytest.mark.asyncio
+async def test_google_provider_rest_tool_round_trip_keeps_user_images(monkeypatch):
+    from landppt.ai.base import AIMessage, ImageContent, MessageRole, TextContent
+
+    payloads = _fake_rest_session(
+        monkeypatch, [{"candidates": [{"content": {"parts": [{"text": "ok"}]}, "finishReason": "STOP"}]}]
+    )
+    messages = [
+        AIMessage(
+            role=MessageRole.USER,
+            content=[
+                TextContent(text="look"),
+                ImageContent(image_url={"url": "data:image/jpeg;base64,eHh4"}),
+            ],
+        ),
+        AIMessage(
+            role=MessageRole.ASSISTANT,
+            content="",
+            tool_calls=[
+                {
+                    "id": "call_1",
+                    "type": "function",
+                    "function": {"name": "read_slide", "arguments": "{}"},
+                    "thought_signature": "sig",
+                }
+            ],
+        ),
+        AIMessage(role=MessageRole.TOOL, content='{"ok": true}', tool_call_id="call_1"),
+    ]
+
+    await _rest_provider().chat_completion(messages)
+
+    contents = payloads[0]["contents"]
+    assert contents[0]["parts"] == [
+        {"text": "[USER]: look"},
+        {"inlineData": {"mimeType": "image/jpeg", "data": "eHh4"}},
+    ]
+    assert contents[1]["parts"] == [
+        {"functionCall": {"id": "call_1", "name": "read_slide", "args": {}}, "thoughtSignature": "sig"}
+    ]
+    assert "data:image" not in str(contents[0])
+
